product_name: FC-H 智慧手机探测门 (29寸)
product_name_en: Smart Phone Detection Gate FC-H (29-inch Display)
summary: FC-H 智慧手机探测门采用领先的电磁波信号探测技术，可精准识别处于开机、关机、移除电池或 SIM 卡状态下的手机。该设备具备强大的智能化排除功能，能有效过滤皮带扣、眼镜、钥匙、钢笔、文具盒等日常金属物品，从而专注于手机、笔记本电脑、iPad、数码相机等电子产品的检测。即使手机被多层铜箔包裹，设备依然能稳定触发声光报警并精确定位报警位置。其独特的 29 寸特大双面液晶屏显示，使其在学校、保密场所及高端安检场景中具备极高的管理效率与视觉冲击力。
summary_en: The FC-H Smart Phone Detection Gate utilizes cutting-edge electromagnetic wave signal detection technology to accurately identify mobile phones in any state, including power-on, power-off, or when the battery and SIM card are removed. This device features a powerful intelligent filtering algorithm that effectively excludes common daily items such as belt buckles, glasses, keys, pens, and stationery boxes, allowing it to focus specifically on detecting electronic products like tablets, laptops, iPads, and digital cameras. Even if a phone is wrapped in five layers of copper foil, the gate reliably triggers audio-visual alarms and pinpoints the exact location of the threat. Equipped with a massive 29-inch dual-sided LCD screen, it offers superior management efficiency and a striking visual impact for schools, secure facilities, and high-end security environments.
key_application: 应用领域：FC-H 智慧手机探测门；采用电磁波信号探测技术，具有排除皮带扣、眼镜、钢笔、文具盒等日常用品进行手机检测的功能，配有29寸超清大屏显示探测位置。
key_application_en: Advanced phone detection for schools and high-security sites; identifies devices even when powered off or disassembled; 29-inch large-screen display for clear tracking; excludes daily metal items (belts, keys) via AI algorithm.
key_parameter_1: 显示器: LG 29寸 (前后双屏)

parameters.探测防区: 12个独立防区 (左右各6区)，准确显示违禁品高度位置
parameters.显示系统: LG 29寸超大前后双屏液晶显示，波形图形化展示
parameters.识别性能: 区分手机与日常用品，手机加装铜箔屏蔽依然感应报警
parameters.操作系统: LINUX 系统，搭载6核高性能处理器 (1.8GHz)
parameters.管理功能: 人员计数 (进/出)、报警历史统计、USB 软件一键升级
parameters.安全防护: 符合国际安全标准，对孕妇、起搏器及磁性介质无害
parameters.校准模式: 自动适应场地干扰校准，屏蔽固定建筑物影响
parameters.定位指示: 门体四侧 360° LED 定位灯同步警报提示
parameters.功耗/电源: 功耗 <40W，外接 187V-242V AC 电源

parameters_en.Detection Zones: 12 independent zones (6 on each side) for precise vertical localization
parameters_en.Recognition Power: Identifies electronics even if wrapped in copper foil; ignores belt buckles/keys
parameters_en.Data Analytics: Traffic flow statistics; alarm log management; USB software updates
parameters_en.Health and Safety: Certified non-hazardous for pacemakers, pregnant women, and credit cards
parameters_en.Calibration: Auto-calibration mode filters site interference and building structures
parameters_en.Visual Alerts: 360° holistic view with dual-pillar synchronized LED indicators

detail_html:
功能特点

  • Product Introduct
  • 区位显示：产品分成12防区，可疑物能在每个区域准确显示。
  • 统计人数：主界面自动显示更新通过人数和报警人数。
  • 四侧定位灯：门体四侧均带有LED灯，能直观地通过定位灯显示违禁物品所在区域，视角可达360°。
  • 声光报警：具有语音报警、灯条闪光报警功能。
  • 高性能CPU：采用6核芯高性能芯片,主频超过1.8GHz。
  • 遥控操作：使用无线鼠标键盘对参数进行设置，参数可以设密码保护，非授权人员无法进行操作。
  • 安全保护：符合国际安全标准，对心脏起博器佩带者、孕妇、磁性介质等无害。
  • 指示灯调试：具有指示灯手动调试功能，可快速排除故障。
